headline_seed: Indian pilot tells PM Modi he opened flydubai cockpit door during attack - Reuters
draft_text:
Flydubai captain Smit Machchhar, stabbed mid-flight, opened the cockpit door so passengers could subdue his co-pilot on flight FZ1073 to Tel Aviv. 174 people were on board. He told PM Modi: "I was fighting for my life."

CBS News and BBC News both confirm.

And that's the mews.
